base_revision.note: read from the repo at run time (git rev-parse HEAD / HEAD^{tree}); the transcripts are provably correlated to this exact revision

http-built-app.pattern: bun run build + node .next/standalone/server.js (the documented runtime package)

composed-runtime.pattern: src/lib/protocol/server-runtime.ts imported in-process (the app’s own composition root)

determinism.pattern: scripts/dogfood_determinism_probe.mjs run twice (fresh composition per run)

telemetry.method: GET /api/ready during the dogfood run (mid-journey, after the HTTP scenarios)

checks.detail: environment resolved as "sandbox" via PAYSWAP_ENV (allowlist sandbox|production, fail-safe sandbox)

action.whatToInspect: the operations.reconciliation-sweep registration and scheduler wiring (a store with no sweep history cannot be assessed for reconciliation health)
the operations.clearing-progression registration and scheduler wiring
the backup manifest (no recovery.backup.completed event and no manifest rows) — take the first backup before any incident, not after

stdout_digest_scope: the deterministic stdout emitted before the corpus emission (the group/scenario JSONL and the report table; the final verdict line follows the identical deterministic content)
